Enum Class BoardType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<BoardType>
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.BoardType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<BoardType>, Constable
public enum BoardType extends Enum<BoardType>
Represents a predefined board configuration for different levels or flight types. Each board defines its flight track length, number of timers, starting positions, reward structure based on position, and bonus for the best ship.
